question: Should the shared autoreview helper permanently make Claude high effort, Fable-refusal retry with Opus-max fallback, and Bedrock profile routing part of its default public policy?
rationale: These choices change default cost and model behavior while establishing a credential-routing contract; implementation tests cannot determine the intended long-term policy.

options.title: Require proof, then adopt
options.body: Accept the direction after redacted subscription, Bedrock, and mixed-provider runs prove the defaults and isolation contract on supported CLI versions.

options.title: Keep routing opt-in
options.body: Merge per-reviewer selection while requiring explicit configuration for Bedrock routing and refusal fallback instead of changing defaults.

options.title: Decline expanded policy
options.body: Retain current panel behavior if the shared skill should not own provider-specific authentication and model-fallback rules.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then adopt
recommendation.body: Accept the direction after redacted subscription, Bedrock, and mixed-provider runs prove the defaults and isolation contract on supported CLI versions.
